description: A line under a general affine map (mixed rotation, scale, shear and translation). As with the shear, a DWG INSERT cannot carry it, so the expected outcome is an unrepresentable classification and quarantine.

profile_only.reason: A single INSERT carries a translation, one rotation, three scales and no shear, so no writer can store this matrix in one INSERT and there is no DWG for this record on purpose. It is a profile-only probe: it states what pvec must do with a single stored matrix of this kind (pvec ADR 0012 and 0017). The DWG path is covered by general-affine-chain-001, a three-INSERT chain that reaches the same world-space line.
